a-memory-of-oils.lead: A Memory of Oils is a knowledge item (recipe or lore note) in Conan Exiles. In-game it is described as: "A treatise explaining the usage of various weapon oils."
body: Spoken in a wavering, ancient voice, this memory note contains the ramblings of an ancient Giant-king on the various oils developed and used by the slaves of the arena.
It is a knowledge item rather than a survival consumable — reading or using it unlocks recipes and lore rather than restoring hunger or thirst.
a-memory-of-oils.verdict: Overall A Memory of Oils is a knowledge item (recipe or lore note) worth reading to unlock its recipes — do not discard it by accident.

absinthe.lead: Absinthe is a drink item and crafting ingredient in Conan Exiles. It restores 21 drink. In-game it is described as: "Powerful liquor of a mystically green hue."
body: A powerful drink, often said to taste like a mixture of dessert and a death god's tears, absinthe is often mixed with water and sugar. Poets, artists, and mad revelers of the most decadent disposition swear by this green drink's reputed powers to cause visions and reveling bedlam. The Mad King of Ophir, Moranthes II, is said drink the stuff with every meal. Absinthe heavily heats the tongue.
It doubles as a crafting ingredient, so it is worth stockpiling rather than consuming at every opportunity.
It stacks up to 20 per inventory slot and weighs 0.1 each.
absinthe.verdict: Overall Absinthe is a drink item and crafting ingredient best stockpiled for crafting.

abysmal-flesh.lead: Abysmal Flesh is a food item and crafting ingredient in Conan Exiles. It restores 53 food. In-game it is described as: "Flesh harvested from the Abysmal Remnant."
body: This foul-smelling, acidic meat does not look or smell appetizing.
It doubles as a crafting ingredient, so it is worth stockpiling rather than consuming at every opportunity.
It stacks up to 100 per inventory slot and weighs 0.1 each.
abysmal-flesh.verdict: Overall Abysmal Flesh is a food item and crafting ingredient best stockpiled for crafting.

ale.lead: Ale is a drink item and crafting ingredient in Conan Exiles. It restores 23 drink. In-game it is described as: "A most refreshing beverage."
body: One of the oldest forms of alcoholic drink devised by man. With just enough alcohol to preserve it, ale can save lives when water is tainted or in short supply. It cools and refreshes.
It doubles as a crafting ingredient, so it is worth stockpiling rather than consuming at every opportunity.
It stacks up to 20 per inventory slot and weighs 0.1 each.
ale.verdict: Overall Ale is a drink item and crafting ingredient best stockpiled for crafting.

aloe-extract.lead: Aloe Extract is a consumable in Conan Exiles. In-game it is described as: "Extract of the aloe plant."
body: Stygian traditions of healing hold that the aloe plant contains many desirable properties. In Luxur, the aloe is harvested for use in the temples of Derketo to cleanse blemishes from the skin of the priestesses. It is often used to sooth oozing wounds and those who ingest it claim that they feel a burst of wellbeing. Whether these effects are of the body or the mind is irrelevant - ingesting aloe.
It is a straightforward consumable — carry a stack on long expeditions to keep your hunger and thirst bars topped up.
It stacks up to 10 per inventory slot and weighs 0.58 each.
aloe-extract.verdict: Overall Aloe Extract is a consumable.

aloe-soup.lead: Aloe Soup is a food item and drink item in Conan Exiles. It restores 41 food. It restores 13 drink. In-game it is described as: "A green soup with no meat at all."
body: Many a survivor knows to apply the juice of the aloe to a burn or to seek the plant's moisture when trekking out in the hot wastes, but certain crones and culinary masters know the healing properties of cooking aloe in a soup. Such a meal offers seemingly instant and moderate relief to the injured.
It is a straightforward consumable — carry a stack on long expeditions to keep your hunger and thirst bars topped up.
It stacks up to 50 per inventory slot and weighs 0.1 each.
aloe-soup.verdict: Overall Aloe Soup is a food item and drink item best kept in your inventory for long journeys.

ambrosia.lead: Ambrosia is a food item in Conan Exiles. It restores 37 food. In-game it is described as: "A dish purported to be blessed by the gods."
body: Worshippers of Mitra often bring sacrifices of fruit or grain to lay upon his altar, in return for his blessing. And occasionally his blessing is very formidable indeed, taking the form of Ambrosia. This bizarre substance, considered a food of the gods, has healing properties that the Priests of Mitra use to bring strength and vitality to the poor. How it is made is pure conjecture, as it seems to.
It is a straightforward consumable — carry a stack on long expeditions to keep your hunger and thirst bars topped up.
It stacks up to 20 per inventory slot and weighs 0.88 each.
ambrosia.verdict: Overall Ambrosia is a food item best kept in your inventory for long journeys.

body: Raw meat is a dangerous temptation for the starving and desperate. Consuming it provides immediate relief from hunger - but at the risk of inheriting any disease or parasite that may have come along for the ride.
It doubles as a crafting ingredient, so it is worth stockpiling rather than consuming at every opportunity.
It stacks up to 50 per inventory slot and weighs 0.1 each.
unappetizing-shellfish.verdict: Overall Unappetizing Shellfish is a food item and crafting ingredient best stockpiled for crafting.

unblemished-human-meat.lead: Unblemished Human Meat is a food item and crafting ingredient in Conan Exiles. It restores 7 food. In-game it is described as: "Carefully harvested, this meat is ritually pure."
body: This flesh has not known the touch of a blade and is therefore ritually pure in the eyes of the Yog religion.
It doubles as a crafting ingredient, so it is worth stockpiling rather than consuming at every opportunity.
It stacks up to 20 per inventory slot and weighs 0.1 each.
unblemished-human-meat.verdict: Overall Unblemished Human Meat is a food item and crafting ingredient best stockpiled for crafting.

vehemence-elixir.lead: Vehemence Elixir is a drink item in Conan Exiles. It restores 3 drink. In-game it is described as: "Ancient desert elixir, drinking causes shivering under the hottest sun and burn the skin on cold winter nights."
body: Created by mad sorcerers of Stygia this elixir allowed their armies to withstand the cruelest of hazards and would have paved a way to conquest of the northern lands was it not for the Aquilonian armies stopping them during the battle of Styx. All the trails revealing a true nature of magical concoctions ended there and recipe was never found.
It is a knowledge item rather than a survival consumable — reading or using it unlocks recipes and lore rather than restoring hunger or thirst.
It stacks up to 10 per inventory slot and weighs 1.75 each.
vehemence-elixir.verdict: Overall Vehemence Elixir is a drink item worth reading to unlock its recipes — do not discard it by accident.

venom-sac.lead: Venom-Sac is a consumable in Conan Exiles. In-game it is described as: "Toxin gland of a monster that, when used, confers a random number of poisons and venoms."
body: Professionals and dabblers beware; extreme caution is advised when handling the delicate membrane of the venom-sac lest the poisoner wish to sample his own product.
It is a straightforward consumable — carry a stack on long expeditions to keep your hunger and thirst bars topped up.

violet-curative.lead: Violet Curative is a drink item in Conan Exiles. It restores 3 drink. In-game it is described as: "A brilliant purple potion that cures everything."
body: Extracted from the venom of various poisonous snakes, this violet potion seems to purge the system of all poisons upon use. Commonly used by street performers in Vendhya to shrug off the effects of cobra bites, more fools have died trying to harvest the ingredients for the curative than would have died if the curative did not exist at all. This concoction also has the added benefit - and drawback.
It is a straightforward consumable — carry a stack on long expeditions to keep your hunger and thirst bars topped up.
It stacks up to 10 per inventory slot and weighs 1.75 each.
violet-curative.verdict: Overall Violet Curative is a drink item best kept in your inventory for long journeys.

war-torn-fodder.lead: War Torn Fodder is a crafting ingredient in Conan Exiles. In-game it is described as: "A strange smelling fodder for pets."
body: Whatever is in this fodder smells unappetizing. However, feeding it to pets seems to change the color of their coats. Nobody seems to know why and nobody seems to have considered that feeding strange food to animals might have unintended effects.
It doubles as a crafting ingredient, so it is worth stockpiling rather than consuming at every opportunity.
It stacks up to 100 per inventory slot and weighs 0.13 each.
war-torn-fodder.verdict: Overall War Torn Fodder is a crafting ingredient best stockpiled for crafting.

weak-aloe-extract.lead: Weak Aloe Extract is a consumable in Conan Exiles. In-game it is described as: "Extract of the aloe plant."
body: Stygian traditions of healing hold that the aloe plant contains many desirable properties. In Luxur, the aloe is harvested for use in the temples of Derketo to cleanse blemishes from the skin of the priestesses. It is often used to sooth oozing wounds and those who ingest it claim that they feel a burst of wellbeing. Whether these effects are of the body or the mind is irrelevant - ingesting aloe.
It is a straightforward consumable — carry a stack on long expeditions to keep your hunger and thirst bars topped up.
It stacks up to 10 per inventory slot and weighs 0.58 each.
weak-aloe-extract.verdict: Overall Weak Aloe Extract is a consumable.

wine.lead: Wine is a drink item and crafting ingredient in Conan Exiles. It restores 22 drink. In-game it is described as: "Bounty of the grape, drink of the gods."
body: The alcoholic beverage made from the grape. Different grapes and different techniques in their fermentation produce different vintages. Wine lightly cools the tongue.
It doubles as a crafting ingredient, so it is worth stockpiling rather than consuming at every opportunity.
It stacks up to 20 per inventory slot and weighs 0.1 each.
wine.verdict: Overall Wine is a drink item and crafting ingredient best stockpiled for crafting.

withered-heart.lead: Withered Heart is a food item in Conan Exiles. It restores 4 food. In-game it is described as: "The heart of a worshipper of Hanuman."
body: This heart was ripped from the chest of a loyal worshipper of Hanuman.
It is a straightforward consumable — carry a stack on long expeditions to keep your hunger and thirst bars topped up.
It stacks up to 20 per inventory slot and weighs 0.1 each.
withered-heart.verdict: Overall Withered Heart is a food item best kept in your inventory for long journeys.

wolf-eye.lead: Wolf-Eye is a crafting ingredient in Conan Exiles. In-game it is described as: "The harvested eyes of a wolf that, when used, confers a new character creation option: Yellow eyes."
body: Since man first stepped from the forest primeval, numerous cultures have upheld the tradition of gaining potency from vanquished foes through the ritual consumption of their blood or body parts.
It doubles as a crafting ingredient, so it is worth stockpiling rather than consuming at every opportunity.
wolf-eye.verdict: Overall Wolf-Eye is a crafting ingredient best stockpiled for crafting.

yamatai-fodder.lead: Yamatai Fodder is a crafting ingredient in Conan Exiles. In-game it is described as: "Fodder that warps animals to Yamatai ways."
body: Blessed by the spirits of the elements, this recipe when fed to certain animals will cause them to grow into idealized totemic animals of the Yamatai people.
It doubles as a crafting ingredient, so it is worth stockpiling rather than consuming at every opportunity.
It stacks up to 100 per inventory slot and weighs 0.1 each.
yamatai-fodder.verdict: Overall Yamatai Fodder is a crafting ingredient best stockpiled for crafting.

yellow-lotus-potion.lead: Yellow Lotus Potion is a drink item in Conan Exiles. It restores 3 drink. In-game it is described as: "A potion that causes hallucinations and visions."
body: The yellow lotus is used by sorcerers to provide visions and trances, with a strong hallucinogenic effect. It is said that those who survive the visions are given a deeper insight into the world, able to communicate with the inner world in a way that rewrites their very physique and increases their stamina.
It is a straightforward consumable — carry a stack on long expeditions to keep your hunger and thirst bars topped up.
It stacks up to 10 per inventory slot and weighs 1.75 each.
yellow-lotus-potion.verdict: Overall Yellow Lotus Potion is a drink item best kept in your inventory for long journeys.

yellow-lotus-soup.lead: Yellow Lotus Soup is a food item and drink item in Conan Exiles. It restores 40 food. It restores 12 drink. In-game it is described as: "Soup boiled from that infamous blossom."
body: While the yellow lotus can make a mind forget its past, one may cook it into a soup and boil out this property. So prepared, it becomes a safe and rather mundane meal, despite the mystical mystique surrounding the flower.
It is a straightforward consumable — carry a stack on long expeditions to keep your hunger and thirst bars topped up.
It stacks up to 50 per inventory slot and weighs 0.1 each.
yellow-lotus-soup.verdict: Overall Yellow Lotus Soup is a food item and drink item best kept in your inventory for long journeys.

zathite-bag.lead: Zathite Bag is a crafting ingredient in Conan Exiles. In-game it is described as: "A bag woven of spider silk."
body: Woven of the finest strands of spider silk, this bag bears the markings of Zath. Usually carried by a devotee of the religion, it could contain anything from spider eggs to temple valuables. The only way to find out, is to open it.
It doubles as a crafting ingredient, so it is worth stockpiling rather than consuming at every opportunity.
zathite-bag.verdict: Overall Zathite Bag is a crafting ingredient best stockpiled for crafting.
